Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the historical pricing you referenced and appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume.

Building on your second package, we can offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit with the AS-14404 index clause and 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for the ongoing discussions. We are always keen to support your range and maintain our strong partnership. 

Regarding our current offer, we can provide a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We welcome your offer of faster payment and have built on your third package to reduce our price to €5.30. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €5.30 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Since we cannot fix prices over a 24-month term, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. 

To fully consider your volume commitment of 23,700 kg, please share the forecast data supporting this figure. Which volume can you commit to? 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
